{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Real_Sistros.jpg|thumb|503x503px|Statue of [[Sistros/Legends|Sistros]], one of the [[Four Sages of Dwartii/Legends|Four Sages of Dwartii]].]]
'''Statuary''' are works of [[Art (COMPNOR)/Legends|art]] that took on a physical form, such as those created by [[Ineas Tikartine]]. [[Marn Hierogryph]] tried to sell makeshift pieces of statuary art on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. Relatively small statues are often called Statuettes. Although most statues are made of stone, there were some instances where they were made of [[Water/Legends|ice]].

Statuaries can be used as a means of honoring something, or someone for an event, with the latter requiring that said someone needed to do something of exceptional service, or as a form of [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]]. The latter was best demonstrated during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] (or, rather, a holosimulation by then-Emperor's Hand [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] of what should have occurred rather than of what actually occurred), where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] told the Imperial officer in charge of taking down the [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] and the Ewoks that, due to his success in the battle, a statue would be made and placed on Coruscant in his honor. Another example is a [[Empire Day Emperor's Statue|statue]] of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that was placed at the steps to Theed Palace on Naboo during the holiday [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]], in honor of his [[Declaration of a New Order|founding]] of the Empire. Another example of this was a [[Statue of Emperor Palpatine|similar statue]] that Emperor Palpatine commissioned in the [[Jedi Trials chamber|Jedi Trials Chamber]] of himself as a testament to his might as well as Sith superiority to the Jedi. On Coronet, a statue of the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and MIA Clone Wars veteran/hero [[Yoda]] was constructed in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], owing to the planet's sympathetic views of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] typically made statues of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] rendering him as an imposing, hooded figure, hiding his facial features. A similar concept would be used millennia later to create statues of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic]] Emperor Palpatine.

The [[Statuary Park]] on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] and the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Statuary Park (Death Star)|Statuary Park]] showcased statues in a space intended for visitors to stroll in.
